title: dryopteris bissetiana
intro: Dryopteris bissetiana, commonly known as Chinese shield fern, is a species of fern native to East Asia. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, including lowering blood pressure, reducing inflammation, and alleviating digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Chinese shield fern include cardiotonic, diuretic, and antispasmodic properties, which contribute to its ability to regulate blood pressure and alleviate symptoms of digestive disorders. The bioactive constituents of Chinese shield fern include flavonoids, saponins, and polysaccharides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
